r: The Sales Expansion Team Leader manages an outbound sales team focused on driving revenue growth from existing clients. This role is responsible for directing lead generation within the current customer base, coaching representatives to cross-sell and upsell new product lines, and executing strategies that directly increase Average Revenue Per User (ARPU).
Handle incoming new branch sales requests from existing customers.
Generate and send quotes promptly, ensuring accuracy and alignment with customer needs.
Track expansion requests and ensure timely follow-ups to close deals efficiently.
Identifying new upselling & cross-selling opportunities from existing customers through outbound activities.
Identify and recommend additional products to maximize revenue from expansion deals.
Ensure that every expansion quote includes relevant upsell/cross-sell products before sending to the customer.
Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of expansion sales.
Communicate effectively with customers regarding their expansion needs and available solutions.
Maintain accurate records of expansion requests in the CRM system.

d: We are looking for a detail-oriented Storekeeper to manage daily store operations, maintain accurate inventory records, and ensure the proper receipt, storage, and issuance of goods.
q: Diploma or relevant qualification in Warehouse Management, Logistics, or Supply Chain is preferred.
2+ years of experience as a Storekeeper or in warehouse operations.
Good knowledge of inventory control and stock management.
Experience using ERP or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and within a team.
r: Receive and inspect incoming goods and verify quantities against delivery documents.
Arrange and store items properly to ensure easy access and efficient space utilization.
Maintain accurate inventory records and update stock movements in the system.
Prepare and issue items based on approved requests.
Monitor stock levels and report shortages, damages, and discrepancies.
Conduct regular stock counts and inventory reconciliation.
Ensure proper documentation of all warehouse transactions.
Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and logistics teams.
Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and safety standards.
